title: Store Update 2.7.0 - Flickering Flames
body:
# Store Update 2.7.0 - Flickering Flames

Raiders!

Update 2.7.0 is rolling out right now, bringing a new Raider Project and the Nessuno Set. No restart required!

The candles are burning bright in Speranza. For the first time, Celeste is gathering members of all four contradas to join in on the celebration of light. As ARC grows more ferocious on the surface, maintaining light in the darkness matters now more than ever.

See you Topside, The ARC Raiders Team
